notes.title: 🛠️ Brooks in Wild West — New Extra Update Now Available! 🤠
notes.content:
Howdy, cowboys and cowgirls!

We’ve got some fresh news for Brooks in Wild West!
After the release of version 1.0, I found a few bugs that needed fixing. But instead of just pushing out a simple hotfix, I decided to take this opportunity to add even more content for you to enjoy.

✅ Here’s what’s included in this extra update:

🔹 New route variants in Chapter 5 — more choices, more paths!
🔹 9 new NSFW scenes added to the gallery.
🔹 New ending variant — now you can choose to either return to your own time or stay in the Wild West.
🔹 Bug fixes in Chapter 4 that were blocking story progression.
🔹 Rebecca will now be at the railway station every Saturday with her repeatable scenes available.
🔹 2 new repeatable interactions with Ivana at the ranch.
🔹 Hidden Easter eggs — explore carefully!

🛠️ General fixes:
Several bugs from version 1.0 have been resolved to ensure smoother and more stable gameplay.

🚀 What’s next?
This is just the first of several extra updates planned!
If you’d like to see exclusive scenes with a specific character, feel free to leave a comment in the community — I’ll be taking your suggestions into account for future updates.

Enjoy the new content, and thanks again for all your support!
See you in the Wild West. 🤠

notes.title: Brooks in Wild West
notes.content:
[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Rework of ALL game scenes (Renders, Animations, Menus, Capsules, Gallery, etc...)
[*] New mechanics for controlling animations in +18 scenes (Switch camera angles, movement speed, zoom and some extra options in specific scenes)
[*] Addition of part of the 4th chapter
[*] Hundreds of new images, animations and dialogues added in previous chapters
[*] Gallery Restructuring
[*] Walktrough improvements
[*] Mission changes
[*] The Cheats option has been disabled and changed to new native game functions (For money you can cheat at Blackjack in the Saloon, for LovePoints and Experience Points you must make special potions and deliver them to the Shaman in the Native Village.)
[*] Restructuring of the Lust system. You now need to have a certain level of Lust to unlock interactions with the girls on the map.
[*] Restructuring of the respect system, every 2 points of respect now generates a 1% discount on the value of various things in the game such as hotel room rentals, guns, horses, etc... Up to a maximum of 50% discount with 100 respect.
[*] PS: Due to the amount of quality improvements the game file size has increased a little.
[*] PS2: I highly recommend starting a new Save to get all the new triggers that were added in previous chapters and get the full experience.
[/list]

Hope you like it!
